common.cache_warning: The local cache could not be read or saved.

actions.refresh: Read the latest Hub snapshot (does not run provider collection)

bar.scope: Selected provider, account and quota window. Percentages are labelled as remaining or used.
bar.no_account: Account {index} is unavailable for this provider
bar.gestures: Left click: open panel · Right click: refresh

error.invalid_url: Set a valid HTTP or HTTPS Hub URL in the plugin settings.
error.credentials_unreadable: The Hub credentials file could not be read.
error.credentials_invalid: The Hub credentials file is invalid.
error.unauthorized: Hub authentication failed. Check the credentials file.
error.network: Could not reach the Hub. Check its address and connection.
error.http: The Hub returned an unsuccessful HTTP response.
error.invalid_response: The Hub returned an invalid stats response.
error.too_large: The Hub response exceeds the supported size.
error.request_rejected: Noctalia could not start the Hub request.
error.processing_error: Local data processing was interrupted. Retry the connection test.

hub_url.label: Hub URL
hub_url.description: Usually leave the local default. In Token Monitor, select Settings → Sync method → Host hub on this device. Use the host’s address and port for a remote Hub.

credentials_file.label: Credentials file override
credentials_file.description: Leave empty for automatic local lookup. A selected file always takes priority: Token Monitor credentials.json or a plain Hub secret. Required for an authenticated remote Hub.

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval
refresh_interval.description: How often to read Hub snapshots. Used only when automatic refresh is enabled; 30–3600 seconds.

bar_provider.label: Bar provider
bar_provider.description: Fallback provider when no account is pinned. A pinned account keeps its own provider.

auto_refresh.label: Automatic refresh
auto_refresh.description: Poll the Hub at the refresh interval. When off, read once at startup; manual refresh remains available.

refresh_on_open.label: Refresh on open
refresh_on_open.description: Read the latest Hub snapshot when opening the panel. This does not trigger provider collection.

bar_style.label: Bar style
bar_style.description: Choose the amount of information shown in the bar.

bar_account_index.label: Fallback bar account number
bar_account_index.description: Used only when no account is pinned. Pin a named account in the Quotas tab to keep its identity stable across Hub reordering.

bar_window.label: Bar quota
bar_window.description: Choose a quota window. Lowest compares only known remaining percentages; missing windows stay unavailable.

bar_show_icon.label: Show bar icon
bar_show_icon.description: Show a provider icon beside text. Icon-only style always keeps its icon.

panel_provider.label: Initial provider filter
panel_provider.description: Provider selected whenever the panel opens. Panel chips change the filter for the current visit.

panel_density.label: Card density
panel_density.description: Compact cards show two windows; comfortable cards show three. Expand an account to see every window.

accounts_per_page.label: Accounts per page
accounts_per_page.description: Limit the number of account cards rendered on each page.

show_account_names.label: Show account and session names
show_account_names.description: Show account labels, session titles and project labels. Turn off to hide these names and session IDs in the UI; local display caches still contain them.

show_progress.label: Show quota meters
show_progress.description: Display meters for known percentages only. Balances never use percentage meters.

show_reset_time.label: Show reset times
show_reset_time.description: Show a reset countdown. Hover the row for the local timestamp; reaching it does not prove quota was refilled.

show_collection_time.label: Show collection times
show_collection_time.description: Show account collection age. Stale accounts always show their age; hover for local time.

warning_threshold.label: Low quota threshold
warning_threshold.description: Warn when a known remaining percentage is at or below this value. Balances and unknown values are excluded.

percentage_mode.label: Percentage display
percentage_mode.description: Display remaining or used quota. Warnings always use the remaining percentage.

initial_view.label: Initial view
initial_view.description: View shown when the panel opens.

usage_period.label: Initial usage period
usage_period.description: Uses the producer’s calendar periods. The Hub does not expose all-time sessions; choose today or this month to view sessions.

history_granularity.label: Initial history grouping
history_granularity.description: Group activity and trends by the source’s daily or monthly records.

details_per_page.label: Details per page
details_per_page.description: Rows per page in Models, Sessions, Activity and Trends.

heatmap_weeks.label: Heatmap range
heatmap_weeks.description: Show 13 or 26 calendar weeks. Missing dates stay visibly separate from recorded zero usage.

heatmap_metric.label: Heatmap metric
heatmap_metric.description: Default daily activity measure. Switch it temporarily from the Activity tab.

auto_discover_credentials.label: Find local credentials automatically
auto_discover_credentials.description: For a local Hub, check standard Token Monitor config paths and up to 32 folders under ~/distrobox. Never sends discovered local credentials to a remote address. A selected file overrides lookup.

pin.toggle: Pin this account to the bar and top of the list; click again to clear
pin.missing: The pinned account is unavailable. Select another account or clear the pin.
pin.save_error: The account selection could not be saved or restored.

analytics.local_truncated: This list was limited locally; totals may include additional records.
analytics.all_time_sessions: The Hub HTTP API does not provide all-time sessions. Select today or this month.
analytics.session_period: Tokens and cost cover the selected period. Session timestamps do not split these counters.
analytics.bucket_boundary: Recorded aggregates. Missing dates are unknown, not zero usage.
analytics.recorded_days: Recorded days in order; spacing does not represent elapsed time.
analytics.recorded_months: Recorded months in order; spacing does not represent elapsed time.
analytics.graph_range: Latest {count} recorded points (up to 30): {first} – {last}. Values are scaled from zero to the peak.
analytics.single_point: One recorded point; see its exact value below.
analytics.attribution_truncated: Model attribution detail was limited locally; the model count includes additional records.
analytics.source_attribution_truncated: The Hub attribution list was limited locally; aggregate totals include additional records.
analytics.daily_heatmap_monthly_list: The heatmap shows daily records; the list below shows monthly totals.
analytics.day_unavailable: No record for this day. Usage is unknown.

balance.partial_month: This month covers tracked days only.

heatmap.title: Activity heatmap
heatmap.missing_help: No daily record was returned for this date.
heatmap.zero_help: A daily record explicitly reports zero for this metric.
heatmap.unknown_help: A daily record exists, but this metric is unavailable.
heatmap.scale_help: Relative intensity: four equal bands up to the visible maximum ({peak}).

connection.title: Connect Token Monitor
connection.subtitle: One local connection for quotas, usage and activity.
connection.address_missing: Set the Hub address in Connection settings.
connection.discovery_searching: Looking for Token Monitor’s local credentials…
connection.discovery_not_found: No local Hub credentials found. Start Host mode, then test again.
connection.discovery_invalid: Local credentials contain no usable Hub secret. Start Host mode or choose a file.
connection.discovery_unreadable: Local credentials could not be read. Choose an accessible credentials file.
connection.discovery_disabled: Automatic lookup is off. Choose a file if the Hub requires authentication.
connection.discovery_remote: Remote Hub: choose its credentials file in Connection settings.
connection.hint_checking: Reading fresh data from both Hub endpoints.
connection.hint_ready: Both data endpoints are available. Provider collection runs in Token Monitor.
connection.hint_empty: Connected successfully. No quota accounts were returned; configure them in Token Monitor.
connection.hint_missing_credentials: This Hub requires authentication. Enable Host mode to create its credentials, or choose the correct file.
connection.hint_unauthorized: The Hub rejected this file’s secret. Check the selected file and Hub address, then test again.
connection.hint_network: Cannot reach the Hub. Keep Token Monitor running in Host mode and check its address and port.
connection.hint_invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS Hub address without a path, query or embedded secret.
connection.hint_unreadable: The selected file cannot be read. Choose an existing file accessible to Noctalia.
connection.hint_invalid_credentials: The selected file needs a Hub secret or Token Monitor’s credentials.json with a host secret.
connection.hint_partial: One data endpoint is unavailable. Check the Hub version; available views remain usable.
connection.hint_response: The Hub did not return supported data. Check its address and Token Monitor version.
connection.step_host: Enable the Hub in Token Monitor
connection.step_host_detail: Settings → Sync method → Host hub on this device. Keep Token Monitor running. Local only does not expose the data this plugin reads.
connection.step_connect: Let the plugin find the credentials
connection.step_connect_detail: On this device, keep the default address and automatic lookup on. For a custom port, remote Hub or unusual install, use Connection settings.
connection.hint_processing: Local data processing was interrupted. Try again when the desktop is less busy.
